hypothesis: PySnooper's get_source_from_frame decodes source files using the locale-dependent default encoding when no PEP-263 coding declaration is present, so a UTF-8 source file containing non-ASCII characters is mis-decoded (mojibake) under a non-UTF-8 locale, corrupting the traced source line.
trigger: Create a temporary module file encoded as UTF-8 whose function body contains a non-ASCII string literal (e.g. 'héllo') and no coding declaration; import it, decorate the function with pysnooper.snoop(string_io), and run it under a non-UTF-8 locale (LC_ALL=C).

oracle.expected_behavior: The trace output must contain the exact non-ASCII source line text (e.g. the literal 'héllo') as written in the UTF-8 file, independent of the process locale.
oracle.target_evidence: pysnooper/tracer.py get_source_from_frame: when source is bytes it sets encoding='ascii' and only overrides it if a PEP-263 coding declaration is found in the first two lines; otherwise it decodes with that encoding. The README and tests (e.g. test_unavailable_source, test_string_io) show source lines are echoed verbatim into trace output, so a mis-decoded line is a functional defect.
oracle.historical_evidence: cookiecutter:1 shows the same class of locale-dependent implicit text decoding bug (UTF-8 data read with platform default encoding); PySnooper:3 is only weakly related (file-output path variable mismatch).

preconditions: pysnooper is importable from the checkout
A temporary directory is writable and importable via sys.path

actions.description: Set LC_ALL=C, PYTHONUTF8=0, PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 in the process environment before importing pysnooper.
Write a temporary module file 'utf8mod.py' encoded as UTF-8 with no PEP-263 coding declaration; its function body contains the non-ASCII string literal 'héllo' on a line that will be traced.
Add the temporary directory to sys.path and import the module so its __loader__ is a normal SourceFileLoader.
Decorate the module function with pysnooper.snoop(string_io) and call it so the tracer executes and emits the source line containing 'héllo'.
Read string_io.getvalue() after the decorated call returns and inspect the trace line corresponding to the non-ASCII source line.

plans.expected_invariant: The trace output contains the exact non-ASCII source line text 'héllo' as written in the UTF-8 file, independent of the process locale.

observable.measurement_point: after the decorated function call completes and the tracer has written the line entry
observable.extraction_method: string_io.getvalue() then search for the substring 'héllo' in the emitted trace lines

assertion.predicate: string_io.getvalue() contains the exact substring 'héllo' and does not contain the replacement character '\ufffd' on the traced source line.
assertion.failure_condition: The trace line shows mojibake or replacement characters instead of 'héllo', indicating the source was decoded with a non-UTF-8 encoding.
assertion.rationale: The invariant is that source lines are echoed verbatim; measuring the emitted trace after invoke directly tests whether get_source_from_frame decoded the UTF-8 bytes correctly under LC_ALL=C.
